data.gender_notes: Sharjith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharjith is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Shar' meaning Ruler and 'Jith' meaning Wealth. This name is believed to be a symbol of power and prosperity. It is a name that is often given to children born into wealthy families or those who are expected to become successful and influential in their lives. The name Sharjith carries the meaning “Ruler of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Malayalam. Parents who choose Sharjith usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharjith is also considered to have deep spiritual significance. It is believed to be a name that is blessed by the gods and is often given to children who are destined to become spiritual leaders or teachers. The name is said to represent the divine power of the universe and is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and success in all areas of life.
